subject: Banking
title: Overdraft Fees: A $30 Billion Business
description: A fast breakdown of Overdraft Fees: A $30 Billion Business for builders.

hook.text: US banks collected $30 billion in overdraft fees in a single year. A $5 coffee that overdraws costs you $35.

buildup.text: Overdraft protection sounds helpful. But it charges $35 each time you spend more than your balance, sometimes daily.

discovery.text: Banks reorder transactions to maximize overdraft fees.

twist.text: 80% of overdraft fees are paid by 9% of customers, usually the poorest account holders living paycheck to paycheck.

climax.text: Overdraft fees are a regressive tax on poverty. The less money you have, the more the bank charges you.

punchline.text: $30 billion from overdrafts. The poorest customers pay the most.

quiz.question: Who pays the most overdraft fees?
options: About 9% of customers, usually the poorest
